description.value: Regard Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster with a physical retail location in north Nanaimo at Metral Drive. The business sells whole-bean coffee, subscriptions, and merchandise both in-store and through its Shopify online store, and also offers wholesale supply. For touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo, it's a dedicated coffee stop with roaster-direct beans.

address.value: 6450 Metral Drive, Unit 100, Nanaimo, BC V9T0L8
